reference.qualification: Completeness is assessed against an expanding evidence-backed feature inventory; string matches alone do not establish reachable features.

autonomy: Choose routine research order, bounded experiments, implementation details and verification without asking the user.
Record evidence, assumptions, discrepancies and unresolved behavior; do not substitute invented behavior for a compatibility contract.
Continue independent work when one dependency is blocked.
Keep the original executable and user datasets unchanged; execute bounded original-process experiments in private working directories.
Keep large local datasets and provider snapshots under ignored analysis/oracle.
Report meaningful progress without requiring replies; preserve checkpoints for continuation.
completion_criteria: Every required feature in the inventory has a recovered behavioral contract and implementation.
External command, file and API compatibility has been defined from evidence and tested.
Representative end-to-end workflows and independently prepared evaluation cases pass comparisons with the reference.
Known required functionality is not left unresolved or silently removed from scope.
Numerical comparison rules are justified; discrepancies and unsupported cases are explicit.
The resulting executable builds reproducibly and ships with regression tests and a coverage report.

Reconstruct command sequencing, editing operations, error behavior and lifecycle around the recovered core.
Freeze candidate implementations before evaluating held-out cases and realistic workflows.
